meta.text: So the recommendation lands on Option B. The reasoning is the important part: the workload is scheduled, so job-cluster pricing applies; the volume varies, so autoscaling fits; and that combination meets the runtime window while respecting the budget. Meanwhile, keep the all-purpose cluster for daytime interactive work, where engineers are actually exploring in notebooks. And here is your exam takeaway — justify a cluster choice with the stated constraint, whether that's schedule, size, latency target, or budget. Never justify it with 'it is the biggest.'
